description:
## Problem
Every shipped DuckDB tuned template requests partitioning: TPC-H (LINEITEM, ORDERS), SSB (LINEORDER) and TPC-DS (6 fact tables). DuckDB always drops it (`benchbox/platforms/duckdb.py:1453-1472`), and dropped intents veto the upgrade (`benchbox/core/tuning/introspection.py:678`). The curated templates defeat their own verification.

## Options
- **(A) Recommended.** Remove partitioning from `examples/tunings/duckdb/*_tuned.yaml` and the packaged mirrors under `benchbox/core/tuning/templates/duckdb/`, and mark DuckDB partitioning `rendered_via="none"`.
- **(B)** Hive-partitioned Parquet in external-table mode only.

## Guardrails
- Keep the `TestPackagedTemplatesParity` test green.
- The requested-config hash changes; record that in release notes.

## Gate protocol
- This is a decision record, not an implementation.
- Implementation items that list this gate in `needs` must not start until it is done.
- The decision owner is the maintainer.
- Record the outcome as a dated ADR addendum (addenda only; do not rewrite recorded decisions) and paste the decision into this item's context before finishing.
